import logging

def setup_logging():
    """
    Configure the logging module for the dev deploy of the billing-sync service.
    
    Returns:
        str: The name of the logging level that was set (e.g., "ERROR").
    """
    # Set the root logger to ERROR level as per standing preference for dev environments
    logging.basicConfig(level=logging.ERROR)
    
    # Return the name of the level that was set
    return logging.getLevelName(logging.ERROR)
